title: Helping a Bit...Hopefully Will Help More As Time Passes
text: Helping a Bit...Hopefully Will Help More As Time Passes. Since the age of 2, I experience nosebleeds all winter long. They are like clockwork...as soon as the heat is turned on in the house for the winter, the nosebleeds begin. We're talking every single day; sometimes more than once a day.  We actually have a whole home humidifier but it doesn't work so great. My nosebleeds started up a few weeks ago. I ordered SAFETY & BEAUTY super quiet humidifier with the hopes that using it while  I sleep will stop the nosebleeds. It is charged by a USB. I do like that there is no electrical cord to operate this . Its easy to operate and has 2 levels of output, low and high. It also has has a built in nightlight that lights up in 7 colors.  (neat feature!) It doesn't make much noise at all and is a nice size.  It fits on the night table right next to me without taking up much room at all. I use the humidifier every night when I'm sleeping . Since using it, I'm still having nosebleeds though I have gone 2 days  without one.  I am having some success with the humidifier and I will continue to use it.  Fingers crossed it will prevent nosebleeds or, at the very least, decrease the amount I have all winter long.
